_about: SEC-112 P0 · the provider registry: ONE row per sign-in provider, read by lib/signin-provider.js only. A provider EXISTS on an installation only when its key is in env SIGNIN_PROVIDERS AND its two client variables AND PUBLIC_API_BASE are set. A new provider is one row here, never code. Shape: docs/FIELDS.md (signin providers).
